mapper.delete: DELETE FROM group_chat_tool_call tool_call USING group_chat_reply_step step, group_chat_turn turn_row, group_conversation conversation WHERE tool_call.reply_step_id = step.id AND step.turn_id = turn_row.id AND turn_row.conversation_id = conversation.id AND conversation.user_world_id = #{userWorldId} AND conversation.mode = 'chat' AND step.id > #{maxGroupReplyStepId}

DELETE FROM group_chat_reply_step step USING group_chat_turn turn_row, group_conversation conversation WHERE step.turn_id = turn_row.id AND turn_row.conversation_id = conversation.id AND conversation.user_world_id = #{userWorldId} AND conversation.mode = 'chat' AND step.id > #{maxGroupReplyStepId}

DELETE FROM group_reply_plan_item item USING group_reply_plan plan, group_conversation conversation WHERE item.plan_id = plan.id AND plan.conversation_id = conversation.id AND conversation.user_world_id = #{userWorldId} AND conversation.mode = 'chat' AND conversation.id > #{maxGroupConversationId}
DELETE FROM user_chat_thinking_history WHERE user_message_id = #{userMessageId}
DELETE FROM user_chat_tool_call WHERE user_message_id = #{userMessageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_chat_history ( id, user_world_id, character_id, content, type, user_message_id, step_no, timestamp ) VALUES ( #{history.id}, #{history.userWorldId}, #{history.characterId}, #{history.content}, #{history.type}, #{history.userMessageId}, #{history.stepNo}, #{history.timestamp} )
INSERT INTO user_chat_thinking_history ( id, user_message_id, step_no, reasoning_content ) VALUES ( #{thinking.id}, #{thinking.userMessageId}, #{thinking.stepNo}, #{thinking.reasoningContent} )

INSERT INTO user_chat_tool_call ( id, user_message_id, step_no, tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_arguments, tool_result ) VALUES ( #{toolCall.id}, #{toolCall.userMessageId}, #{toolCall.stepNo}, #{toolCall.toolCallId}, #{toolCall.toolName}, #{toolCall.toolArguments}, #{toolCall.toolResult} )

INSERT INTO user_character_favor_log ( id, user_world_id, character_id, favor_update, binding_type, binding_chat, timestamp ) VALUES ( #{favorLog.id}, #{favorLog.userWorldId}, #{favorLog.characterId}, #{favorLog.favorUpdate}, #{favorLog.bindingType}, #{favorLog.bindingChat}, #{favorLog.timestamp} )

INSERT INTO world_event_log ( id, user_world_id, event_description, visible_characters, timestamp, title, conversation_id ) VALUES ( #{worldEventLog.id}, #{worldEventLog.userWorldId}, #{worldEventLog.eventDescription}, #{worldEventLog.visibleCharacters,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{worldEventLog.timestamp}, #{worldEventLog.title}, #{worldEventLog.conversationId} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET user_world_id = EXCLUDED.user_world_id, event_description = EXCLUDED.event_description, visible_characters = EXCLUDED.visible_characters, timestamp = EXCLUDED.timestamp, title = EXCLUDED.title, conversation_id = EXCLUDED.conversation_id
